summary: This CSS file styles a small action bar containing a copy button and a raw link, typically used in blog articles. The wrapper uses inline-flex to keep everything in a row with consistent spacing, and both the button and link have hover states that change their appearance when users interact with them.

explanations.7: inline-flex makes the children line up horizontally like flexbox, but the container itself only takes up as much width as its contents need, rather than stretching full width.
explanations.15: var(--ifm-color-emphasis-700) is a CSS custom property (variable) that pulls a color value from the design system; this lets you update the color in one place and it changes everywhere.
explanations.27: :not(:disabled) is a selector that means 'apply this style only when the element is NOT in the disabled state', so the hover effect doesn't trigger on disabled buttons.
explanations.37: This hover state changes the link color to the primary theme color, giving visual feedback that the link is interactive.
